quarterly_data.quarter: Lumen Technologies press release: Lumen Launches Intelligent Internet, Bringing Cloud-Like (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lumen launched Lumen Intelligent Internet, the next evolution of its enterprise internet offering: customers buy connectivity in minutes and scale bandwidth up or down, provisioning and adjusting it digitally through Lumen Connect or APIs, with term-based pricing that combines a predictable monthly rate with on-demand flexibility, pre-ordering with a new fabric port, and DDoS Essentials and Lumen Defender security; the experience was first delivered through Internet On-Demand. It is available now to enterprise customers at more than 10 million U.S. business locations, with bandwidth scalable up to 100 Gbps, on Lumen's global internet backbone. Named early users: iVision, SABIS, Skyway Studios and the New York Yankees. Chief technology and product officer Jim Fowler: 'AI is making demand harder to predict, not easier.' No pricing, revenue or customer-count figures stated.
quarterly_data.figure: available at more than 10 million U.S. business locations; bandwidth scalable up to 100 Gbps
